site.name: The Long Ball
site.tagline: Digging the data behind the distance.

description: A season-to-date team-context read comparing actual and expected wOBA on tracked, non-home-run balls in play.
definition: Actual minus expected wOBA on tracked, non-home-run balls in play. It measures the gloves and the bounces together: defense and batted-ball luck are not separated.
interpretation: Negative defenseSubsidy means actual results were better than the contact expectation, so the staff was helped. Positive means the staff was hurt.
warnings: Descriptive team context for this season only; not a pitcher-skill stat, plus metric, or projection input.
The number combines the gloves and the bounces. It does not isolate defense from batted-ball luck.
Home runs are excluded because a defense cannot field them; Getting Cooked is shown separately for HR-capable contact.
Pitcher rows are descriptive staff detail and require the frozen BIP qualifier; team totals include every eligible staff BIP.

fields.team: MLB team abbreviation for the pitching staff.
fields.leagueRank: Rank from most helped (1) to most hurt (30) by raw defenseSubsidy.
fields.staffBip: All tracked, non-home-run terminal fair BIP allowed by the staff, including sub-qualifier pitchers.
fields.bip: Pitcher's tracked, non-home-run terminal fair BIP sample.
fields.actualWobaOnBip: Mean realized wOBA value on the eligible BIP sample.
fields.expectedWobaOnBip: Mean historical-league expected wOBA from exit velocity, launch angle, and batted-ball type.
fields.defenseSubsidy: Actual minus expected wOBA on eligible BIP, stored unrounded. Negative means helped; positive means hurt. It combines the gloves and the bounces.
fields.cookedPlus: Getting Cooked plus-style score for HR-capable contact allowed per BBE; 100 is qualified-pitcher average. Null means unavailable or unqualified in the same-vintage Hot Dog Stand payload.

source.expectation: Historical-league HGB actual-wOBA expectation from EV, LA, and batted-ball type
